{{Quote|You are going to have to stay here. These are good people, Padmé. You'll be safe.|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Episode II" />}}
The '''Lars family''' was a family that lived primarily on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The earliest known member of the Lars family was [[Lef Lars/Legends|Lef Lars]]. With his wife, [[Gredda Lars/Legends|Gredda]], they had two sons named [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg]] and [[Edern Lars/Legends|Edern]]. Cliegg married [[Aika Lars/Legends|Aika]] and had a son named [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen]]. After Aika died, Cliegg married [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]], whom he freed from slavery. Cliegg's son, Owen, married a girl named [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru Whitesun]].

When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], the son of Shmi, became Darth Vader, his son, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], was cared for by Owen and his wife, Beru Whitesun, whom he called "Uncle Owen" and "Aunt Beru." They were killed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Since they had no blood descendants, the family line ended with them.

It is possible that Luke's aunt [[Coolie]] was connected in some way with the Lars family.
